items.notes: Accurately distinguishes SLI observation from SLO target with population, budget and synthetic-data caveats; fully grounded in the cited sections.
Thorough priority-queue mechanics and starvation controls, but omits the expected admission migration/rollback, storage-local boundary and explicit failure-recovery points.
Correctly explains WAL-replayed deletion, promotion limits and the PITR alternative; covers the major expected points although RTO/RPO terminology is not used.
Strong off-CPU explanation, but the expected hot-key trap and connection-pool-capacity points are absent.
Accurately explains earliest-retained behavior and the need for source snapshot or backfill; concise but covers the core recovery decision.
Correctly lists the provenance fields, snapshot attribution and stale-edge rule; covers the major traceability points.
Correctly confines a candidate failure to the comparison channel and preserves old authority; covers the expected parallel-run and shadow-traffic points.
Maps personalization and uncacheability to static-hosting contraindications and cache-authority limits; covers the expected points.
Correctly separates liveness from readiness and keeps shared-dependency checks out of liveness; covers the expected points.
Formula, near-zero denominator and convergence caveats are accurate and correctly bounded.
Sanity conditions, candidate values and the V12 rejection rule are accurate; covers the expected points.
Per-attempt timeout reset and stale-event handling match the model; retry and determinism points are covered.
